out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. PIC AGREED TO VOLUNTARILY CLOSED DUE TO LACK OF WORKING REFRIGERATION AND TCS FOOD ITEMS IN THESE COOLERS NOT PROPERLY COLD HOLDING.
violations.corrective_action: PIC WILL ENSURE NSF COLD HOLDING UNITS ARE COLD HOLDING PROPERLY AND NEW NSF-APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT COLD HOLDING UNITS ARE PICKED OUT AND APPROVED BY THE EHS PRIOR TO REQUESTING A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO REOPEN.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEES WASH HANDS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF ARE TRAINED ON PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES AGAIN AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at BACK handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EMPLOYEE PURCHASED MORE PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED BACK HANDWASHING SINK WITHOUT SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNAGE IS POSTED AT THE HANDWASHING SINK AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH VARIOUS UTENSILS WITHOUT SANITIZING AT THE THREE-VAT SINK DURING THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE ON PROPER SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF ARE TRAINED IN PROPER WASHING, RINSING, AND SANITIZING PROCEDURES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED FRENCH FRIES AT 89-104F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL HOT HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE. FRENCH FRIES WERE DISCARDED OF DURING INSPECTION. BITEZ 3 (Inspection Date: 07/21/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CUT LETTUCE AT 61F AND DICED TOMATOES AT 48F IN THE FIRST 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER; OBSERVED FRENCH FRIES AT 52F AND SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 70F IN THE RED BULL COOLER, OBSERVED CONTAINERS OF WHITE SAUCES AT 48-53F AND SHREDDED CHEESE BETWEEN 45-49F IN THE 2-DOOR GLASS-FRONT COOLER; OBSERVED CONTAINER OF RAW CHICKEN AT 45F, GYRO MEAT AT 44-50F, RAW CHICKEN CONTAINER #2 AT 50-55F, AND RAW CHICKEN #3 AT 49-53F IN THE 1-DOOR COOLER NEAR THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PIC WILL ENSURE ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F TO ENSURE FOODS CAN COLD HOLD PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED TWO BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS IN SPRAY BOTTLES WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC ADDED LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL CHEMICALS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY LABELED.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: OBSERVED NO THERMOMETER IN THE FIRST 1- DOOR UPR COOLER AND THE 1-DOOR UPR CLOSEST TO THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE ENSURE ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS WITH TCS FOODS HAVE A UNIT THERMOMETER. BITEZ 3 (Inspection Date: 07/21/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: OBSERVED FRONT 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER AND RED BULL COOLER (BOTH IN BACK KITCHEN), AND HOT HOLDING EQUIPMENT AT THE SERVICE LINE AREA INSTALLED WITHOUT HEALTH DEPARTMENT APPROVAL. BOTH REFRIGERATORS ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOLERS MUST BE REPLACED WITH NSF-APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT COOLERS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE HOT HOLDING EQUIPMENT SHOULD BE PROVIDED TO THE EHS; IF IT IS NOT NSF APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT IT SHALL NOT BE USED.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE SMALL 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER AT 62F WITH EHS THERMOMETER, RED BULL COOLER AT 48F, AND 2-DOOR SLIDING GLASS-FRONT COOLER AT 44-52F. TCS FOODS WERE ALSO NOT COLD HOLDING IN THE 1-DOOR GLASS FRONT COOLER NEAR THE COOK-LINE, BUT OBSERVED AT 40F WITH EHS THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC UNDERSTANDS THE RED BULL COOLER AND THE 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER NEAR KITCHEN ENTRANCE ARE NOT NSF- APPROVED AND ARE NOT PERMITTED TO BE USED. THE OTHER TWO COOLERS NEED TO BE REPAIRED AND MORE NSF-APPROVED COOLERS FOR PURCHASE SHOULD BE PROVIDED TO THE EHS PRIOR TO REQUESTING A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK BETWEEN 94-104F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PLEASE ENSURE THE THREE-VAT SINK CAN MEET 110F AT A MINIMUM WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS IN THE 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER CLOSEST TO THE COOK-LINE AND THE TWO-DOOR SLIDING GLASS-FRONT COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THE INTERIOR OF THESE COOLERS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. PIC HAS NOT RECEIVED 2025 PERMIT.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PIC WILL ENSURE PERMIT IS OBTAINED AND POSTED IN PUBLIC VIEW AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PIC CAN REACH OUT TO EHS IF PERMIT NEEDS TO BE MAILED TO ESTABLISHMENT AGAIN.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE EHS WITH SIGNED COPIES OF EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH COPIES OF EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY AND WILL EMAIL PIC MORE COPIES.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED PIC A COPY OF CLEANUP PROCEDURE.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: OBSERVED CREPE UTENSILS IN A CONTAINER OF AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER ON COUNTER-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED CREPE UTENSILS FROM STANDING WATER DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS UTENSILS SHOULD BE KEPT IN A DRY CONTAINER OR A CONTAINER OF HOT WATER AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE UTENSILS SHOULD NOT BE USED AS THEY ARE NOT FOOD-GRADE. PIC WILL DISCONTINUE USE AND PURCHASE FOOD-GRADE UTENSILS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
